profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar. On its own site the company says it builds lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and that it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, delivering mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It frames lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that supports features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot) as well as advanced semi-autonomous driving.

The company also states that autonomous vehicles such as robotaxis and robobuses need advanced sensing to operate safely with little or no human input, and that its sensors are built to meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, which it says supports large-scale deployment of autonomous fleets globally. Its stated focus spans ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications.

The record holds no litigation and no tracked products for the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001861737, headquarters in Shanghai, and for-profit public company status.
